bio: The essence of the sea in the heart of the Spanish capital! Here, top-quality products take centre stage, with a focus on superbly prepared fish and seafood that can’t be bettered – an impression backed up by the exclusive array of quality ingredients visible in the display cabinet. The main object here is to eat well, of course, but we recommended not going alone as many of the fish served are large in size and these may not be available just for one person....
